// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// A file whose only occurrence of the word `from` is at the END of a string
// literal. There is no import here beyond the two permitted ones, and the
// scanner must not invent one.
//
// The regression this pins (F54), which is F52's mechanism for the third time:
// with an unconstrained `[^"']+` capture, a string ending in `from` puts a
// CLOSING quote where the pattern expects an opening one, and the capture runs
// to the next quote in the file:
//     export const note = "a phrase ending in from";
//     const path = "@/lib/ops/session";
//   captured specifier: `";\nconst path = "`
//
// It fits on one line too, which is why constraining the class to exclude a
// newline was not enough:
//     export const note = "ending in from"; const p = "@/lib/x";
// Both shapes are below. A constrained class cannot express either capture.
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { requireOperator } from "@/lib/ops/session";

export const note = "a phrase ending in from";
const path = "@/lib/ops/session";

export const oneLiner = "ending in from"; const p = "@/lib/x";

export async function register() {
  await requireOperator();
  return { total: await db.establishment.count(), note, path, p };
}
